tagline: A tamper-evident trust layer for institutional auditing
brief: Brand mark for AuditLinkTrail (ALT), a tamper-evident trust layer for institutional auditing. It should feel institutional, official and precise, carried by the existing gold-on-carbon identity. Replaces the previous interlocking-links icon.
criteria: Success: reads as official without padlock/shield/chain clichés, survives 16 px in docs and terminal, one-colour safe for print, coherent with the gold-on-carbon deck.

concepts.name: Assay Seal
concepts.idea: A notched official seal roundel whose negative space forms the A — audit as assay, the gold-standard mark of authenticity.
rationale: The most conventionally institutional of the three
No existing marks own the seal-hallmark intersection in the category

concepts.name: Waypoint A
concepts.idea: An A drawn as an ascending trail with a diamond waypoint at the apex — every path leads up to the record.
rationale: Carries trail, link and audit in one mark
Cleanest at 16 px — favicon, terminal, GitHub
The diamond seeds the icon system

concepts.name: Ledger A
concepts.idea: An A ruled into sealed horizontal courses between slanted legs — institutional masonry, every line a ledger entry.
rationale: Very institutional, prints beautifully in one colour
Some read pyramid first; the ledger story is the quietest

recommendation: Waypoint A — strongest intersection of the name, cleanest small, and the gold diamond on carbon is unmistakably ALT. Client picked B (Waypoint A).
